This system uses GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-7|nowpayments]] for crypto payments. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. No revenue loss. This is how digital creators in Kenya — and every region Stripe locked out — sell beats online without permission.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a complete commerce stack you own and control. GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, like triggering file downloads after payment. Supabase stores order data securely. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, converting USD to stablecoins like USDT or USDC. The buyer pays in crypto. You receive it instantly. No buyer account required. No KYC. No 0.5% fee until the payment confirms. This architecture solves three problems: payment rejection, currency instability, and platform dependency. You’re not renting infrastructure — you’re deploying it. After setup, COREMERCH has no access. You own the code. You own the data. You own the revenue stream. This is infrastructure sovereignty, built for creators who need it.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the flow: The buyer visits your GitHub Pages store. They select a beat and pay in crypto via NOWPayments. The payment confirms on-chain (BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees). A webhook fires, triggering a Cloudflare Worker. The Worker verifies the payment, logs the order in Supabase, and sends a secure download link via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The buyer gets the beat instantly. You get the payment. No manual intervention. No failed transactions. The system is stateless — it runs without servers you manage. Cloudflare Workers scale automatically. Supabase handles database queries. GitHub Pages serves static files. NOWPayments handles payment verification. Each component is free or low-cost. The entire stack deploys in 48 hours. This isn’t theoretical — it’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling beats, ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, plugins, or software in regions where conventional payment processors fail. If Stripe or PayPal blocks your transactions, this stack is your solution. If your local currency is unstable, this stack lets you price in USD and receive stablecoins. If you’re tired of platform fees and lock-in, this stack gives you full ownership. It’s not a workaround — it’s a replacement. It’s not for everyone. If you need hand-holding or prefer renting infrastructure, this isn’t for you. But if you want to own your commerce stack, deploy it once, and never pay subscriptions again, this is how. It’s built for creators who choose better architecture, not victims who settle for workarounds.
Own your store. Own your payments. Own your data. This is infrastructure sovereignty.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, like payment verification and file delivery. Supabase stores order data securely, with real-time queries. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores your beat files for instant delivery. Each component is free or low-cost. They integrate via APIs and webhooks. GitHub Pages serves static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Cloudflare Workers run serverless functions. Supabase provides a PostgreSQL database. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain. The system is modular — swap components as needed. For example, replace Supabase with Google Sheets for simpler setups. Replace GitHub Pages with Cloudflare Pages for faster global delivery. The stack is yours to customize. The Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints and templates to deploy this architecture today.

Configure NOWPayments for your preferred cryptocurrencies. Test end-to-end. Launch your store. The kit includes a scaling playbook to handle increased traffic and a NOWPayments integration guide. You’re not buying a tool — you’re buying infrastructure sovereignty. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. You own everything. This is how digital creators in Kenya — and every region Stripe locked out — sell beats online without permission.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling beats online with crypto payments means deploying a sovereign commerce stack that doesn’t rely on Stripe, PayPal, or other blocked platforms. Use GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. The buyer pays in crypto (e.g., USDT on BSC). The payment confirms on-chain. A webhook triggers file delivery. You receive payment instantly. No buyer account required. No KYC. No platform fees after deployment. This architecture is owned and controlled by you, giving you full data ownership and revenue sovereignty.
No platform fees. No subscriptions. No revenue loss. Deploy once, own forever.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’ve never coded before?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints designed for non-developers. Follow the step-by-step guides to deploy your stack. No coding required for basic setups.
What cryptocurrencies can buyers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON. Buyers can pay in USDT, USDC, or any coin you enable.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. The architecture is serverless. GitHub Pages hosts your store. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase manages the database. No server maintenance required.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments automatically retries failed payments. If the payment doesn’t confirm on-chain, the buyer won’t receive the download link. You’re protected from incomplete transactions.
Can I sell products other than beats?
Yes. This architecture works for ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, plugins, software, and any digital product. The file delivery system is universal.
